name: TV Release Identity & Reliability Hardening
changes: Anchors TV release identity to the complete series prefix before the first season/episode marker, preventing episode-title and unrelated-series collisions such as FROM/Home Away from Home and Love Island matches inside other shows.
Uses the same strict persisted title/country-edition identity for search eligibility, final Grab validation, Smart Import, library scanning, and a read-only Needs Review integrity audit.
Prefers the proven TV series directory during library scans and refuses to learn a series directory from a stale cross-title episode record.
Safely prunes only expired Automation Grab reservation files and exposes cleanup counters without weakening cross-process duplicate-Grab protection.
Adds a configurable percentage free-space reserve, combined with the existing GB minimum, and blocks grabs/imports when a media or staging drive would fall below reserve.
Fixes Windows backend working-set diagnostics by using typed 64-bit process-memory APIs and reports an explicit memory telemetry error instead of silently returning zero.
Separates generic SAB engine warnings from provider/network summaries and disk faults so messages such as NZB import warnings are not misreported as Usenet provider failures.
Makes launcher startup-log release identity dynamic from version.txt and adds permanent production regression guards for the launcher marker and strict TV identity tests.
regression_guards: Existing country-edition aliases remain bounded to the persisted TV country identity; conflicting explicit editions are rejected and ambiguous franchise matching is not broadened.
The integrity audit is read-only and never deletes, moves, renames, or automatically repairs existing media; suspicious records are reported as Needs Review.
Active Grab reservation files are never pruned before their expiry and malformed reservation files receive an additional age grace before removal.
The v3.6.41 Downloads snapshot responsiveness path and v3.6.20+ serialized SAB transport remain intact.
v3.6.40 runtime-storage cleanup, v3.6.39 startup-reservation refinement, and v3.6.38 crash-recovery/authoritative queue-admission protections remain intact.
Manual Search/Grab, no-downgrade Smart Import safety, source-freshness protections, installer service/tray handoff, and user-data locations remain unchanged.
